about: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (MoE, 3B active) UD-IQ2_M on one 6 GB card: --load-mode none keeps the whole 11.5 GB model in host RAM and is the difference between a usable and an unusable server here. With the default mmap load the CPU-resident expert tensors are page-faulted from NVMe on every token: measured 0.035 tok/s on a cold cache and 38 tok/s once warm. --load-mode none costs ~12 GB of host RAM and serves 36.4 tok/s from the first request. No --n-gpu-layers, so llama.cpp auto-fits what fits in 5.2 GB of free VRAM and leaves the rest on the CPU; that beat every pinned layer count tried (8/12/16 -> 24.8/26.1/27.6 tok/s, 20 and 24 OOM). q8_0 KV, 65536 context on one slot. Measured on an RTX 3050 6GB (PCIe 4.0 x8, H2D 13.1 GB/s, Ryzen 5 7600X, 30 GB RAM).
